summary.text: Brandon Smith is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 30 since 2008 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Smith served in the Kentucky House of Representatives from 2001 to 2008 and as a commissioner for the City of Hazard from 1993 to 1998.
His professional experience includes work as retail operations director for Perry Oil Company, vice president of Hazard Food Mart, Inc., and owner of Daniel Boone Investments.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Banking and Insurance, Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection, Natural Resources and Energy (chair), and Transportation committees.
Smith and his wife, Jamie, have three children.
